'ETO NA YATA ANG BIG ONE WHEN IT COMES TO FLOODING'

WATCH: President Bongbong Marcos says some DPWH equipment have remained idle for seven years, supposedly reserved for the so-called "Big One" or the devastating earthquake that may strike Metro Manila.

Authorized trip at walang ginamit na pondo ng pamahalaan — ito ang nilinaw ni Cebu 5th District Rep. Duke Frasco tungkol sa kaniyang naging trip patungong London noong nakaraang linggo kung kailan nanalasa ang Bagyong #TinoPH.

Paliwanag ni Frasco, isa itong "authorized official mission" bilang bahagi ng Philippine delegation sa World Travel Market (WTM), isang event na aniya'y mahalagang plataporma sa pagsulong ng "international partnerships, investments, at economic opportunities" sa bansa.

Sinabi rin ng kongresista na "founded on erroneous assumptions" at "misrepresentations of fact and law" ang mga reklamong inihain laban sa kaniya.

"I arrived in London on November 4, and upon learning of the severe flooding that struck parts of Cebu, I immediately made arrangements to return to the Philippines the very next day," aniya.
